items.title: 배경 — 모텔 카운터 (회상)
items.desc: The cramped front lobby of an old Korean motel around 2010, late at night: a small reception window with a sliding frosted-glass hatch set in the back wall on the right, a key rack with numbered wooden key tags (no numbers drawn) behind it, a tacky fake potted palm, a red carpet, pink-purple neon light spilling in from the left.

items.title: 젊은 시절 아빠 — 카운터 앞에서 굳음 (회상)
items.note: 같은 사람의 10년 전. 머리숱만 많고 옷이 다르다.
items.desc: The same man about ten years younger: a full head of thick black hair, slimmer, wearing a navy padded jacket and jeans instead of the cardigan. 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Frozen stiff with embarrassment at a counter: shoulders up to his ears, face bright red, eyes wide and staring at nothing, a rigid clenched-teeth smile, one hand holding out a credit card that is slipping from his trembling fingers, cold sweat flying.

items.title: 장면 — 귀족의 저택에서 시작된 호텔
items.desc: 18th-century France. A grand aristocratic townhouse (hôtel particulier) with a red mansard roof, tall arched windows and a stone gate. A pompous French nobleman in a powdered wig and embroidered coat steps down from a horse-drawn carriage with his nose in the air, while a bowing butler holds the front door open and a servant staggers under a ridiculous tower of luggage. European people, daytime, warm light.

items.title: 장면 — 자동차 여행객을 위한 모텔
items.desc: 1920s America, a desert highway at dusk. A long single-storey roadside motor inn with a row of identical doors, and a black Ford Model T parked directly in front of one door. A dusty, exhausted American driver in a flat cap and driving goggles stands yawning hugely next to the car, one hand still on the car door and the other already reaching for the room door, to show that the bed is one step from the car. A blank roadside sign on a pole. American people.

items.title: 장면 — 1912년, 한 교사가 만든 유스호스텔
items.desc: Germany, 1912, green hills. A cheerful German schoolteacher with a big moustache, round glasses, a felt hat, knee breeches and a walking stick marches at the front, pointing proudly ahead at an old stone castle-like school building on a hill. Behind him a line of five tired but excited schoolchildren with huge backpacks and walking sticks follow in single file, one of them lagging and gasping. European people, bright daytime.

items.title: 소품 — 호텔 건물
items.desc: A grand classic luxury hotel building seen straight from the front: several storeys, a red mansard roof, a golden revolving door with a red carpet and a small canopy, flags on the roof. Slightly chubby, toy-like proportions. No people.

items.title: 소품 — 모텔 건물
items.desc: A low single-storey American roadside motel seen straight from the front: a row of three doors, a flat roof with a tall blank neon arrow sign, and a small vintage car parked right in front of a door. Slightly chubby, toy-like proportions. No people.

items.title: 소품 — 유스호스텔 건물
items.desc: A friendly two-storey youth hostel seen straight from the front: timber-framed walls, a steep green roof, a wide open wooden door, and a pile of colorful hiking backpacks and walking sticks leaning by the entrance. Slightly chubby, toy-like proportions. No people.

items.title: 장면 — 다음 편 예고 (아파트 · 빌라 · 오피스텔)
items.desc: A Korean city street at dusk with three very different buildings standing side by side and filling the frame: on the left a tall slab-shaped apartment block with many identical balconies, in the middle a small four-storey red-brick villa with an open pilotis car park on the ground floor, on the right a slim glass officetel tower. A huge cartoon question mark shape floats in the sky above them. No people.
